title: The Loudest Sticky Note
logline: One founder, one Monday morning, forty deals shouting for attention and a new hire holding out empty hands — until the tangle tied to her head is pulled taut into a ground line, the one thing to do first shows up in orange with its reason in blue, she presses a slipping deal back onto the ground with her own hand, and everything she did settles into a short green book her first sales hire can run from.
tagline: Your first hire could run this.

beats.vo: You've got forty deals, and the loudest sticky note wins.
beats.vo_spoken: You've got forty deals, and the loudest sticky note wins.
beats.on_screen: Masking-tape label, handwritten, top-left: "Founder · Monday morning" · tally marks in the margin, in gates of five, up to 40 · the first six notes read Boeing, Starbucks, Notion, OpenAI, Chipotle, Sweetgreen · the loud note reads "!!!"
beats.visual: Bright cool-white notebook page (#F6F8FC) with a faint graph-paper grid; the whole page stays in view for the entire film — no camera moves. A cut-out paper desk (cream fill, deep-navy marker outline, slightly torn edges, soft drop shadow) slides up into the bottom-left and lands; the film's ground line will later run at its top edge. The founder is already seated behind it — a simple cut-out person, cream card body, navy outline, round head, a marker face doing its best — with a paper mug beside her whose steam squiggle boils. A masking-tape strip peels onto the top-left corner with the handwritten label 'Founder · Monday morning'. Her paper hand slaps one cream sticky note onto the desk (a doodled glue strip along its top edge): 'Boeing · call back?'. Then notes start landing on their own — 'Starbucks', 'Notion', 'OpenAI', 'Chipotle', 'Sweetgreen' as five more readable slaps, then a blur of scribbled ones in one accelerating shuffle — each slightly rotated, until forty of them heap up on the desk with curling corners. The tally in the margin ticks up in gates of five (eight pen strokes, not forty). She presses her free hand flat on top of the heap to hold it down; the last note, bigger than the rest with a shouting marker mouth and '!!!', squeezes out from under her palm and hops up and down on top of the pile. Only navy ink and cream paper; no accent colour anywhere yet.
beats.sound: Music in on the first slap: sparse, dry and whimsical — kalimba and nylon-string guitar over a warm upright bass and brushed snare, unhurried (no ukulele). Soft thunk as the desk lands; tape peel for the label; eight pen scratches for the tally gates; six sticky-note paper slaps that dissolve into one rapid accelerating shuffle; a squeaky paper wobble each time the loud note hops.

beats.vo: You know where they really stand. You can't hand over your head.
beats.vo_spoken: You know where they really stand. You can't hand over... your head.
beats.on_screen: Serif, lower third, set on the word "hand": "You can't hand over your head." · thought-bubble cards in handwriting: "Chipotle · waiting on legal" / "Sweetgreen · our contact left?" / "Notion · call back Tuesday" · small paper tile taped top-right, navy: "You are the system" · a boiling handwritten "?" above the hire
beats.visual: Same page, no push-in. The VO starts at about 4.8 as a paper thought bubble unfolds above the founder's head (three cut-out puffs, a bit of tape at the join); inside it, tiny deal cards bob and float, each with its real state scribbled on it. The bubble is tied to her temple by a tangled navy string — a boiling knot of marker. While the knot boils, a small paper tile is taped into the top-right corner reading 'You are the system' in navy; it stays there, ignored, until beat 8. On 'You can't' (about 7.8) the new hire walks in from the right edge at desk-top height with a two-frame paper-puppet walk: kraft-brown paper (a different texture from hers), a lanyard, a notebook, hands held out palms-up. On 'hand over' she stands, grips the bubble with both hands and tries to pass it to him like a parcel; the serif line sets in the lower third on 'hand'. On 'head' (about 10.0) the string pulls taut, twangs, and the bubble snaps back over her own head with a wobble, the little cards rattling. His hands stay empty; a wobbly handwritten '?' pops above his head. Then a full second of comic stillness (10.2–11.2): nothing moves but the string swinging and the loud note hopping on the pile. In the last half-second the calm paper hand — larger, the film's hand from here on, never a stand-in for the product doing her work — enters from the right and pinches the loose end of the string. Still navy ink only; the pain has no colour.
beats.sound: Pen scribble as the bubble unfolds; tiny paper flutters for the floating cards; a small tape press for the tile; three soft paper footsteps for the hire; a string twang and a papery 'thwup' as the bubble snaps back; a small pop for the '?'. Music dips a half-step and thins to bass only; near-silence under the stillness, just the string creaking and the note's squeak.

beats.vo: Nobody could beat the giant Antaeus while his feet touched the ground. Lifted, he went weak.
beats.vo_spoken: Nobody could beat the giant Antaeus while his feet touched the ground. Lifted, he went weak.
beats.on_screen: Serif, top of page: "Antaeus" · handwritten beneath it: "named for the giant" · handwritten beside the lifted giant: "lifted = weak · same with deals" · handwritten by the green ticks on the landing: "grounded = strong"
beats.visual: At 11.5 the hand pulls the string taut across the whole page with a snap: the knot unravels, the bubble deflates to a scrap, and the string straightens into one clean navy ground line at desk-top height, running off both edges of the page and under the hire's feet on the right (his '?' fades out as the line runs under him; he waits at the right margin, standing on the line, through beat 7). The little deal cards drop straight out of the collapsing bubble onto the line just right of the desk in one loose gravity scatter — no tidying yet. The founder's head is free; her marker mouth ticks up one notch. The serif 'Antaeus' writes itself at the top of the page with 'named for the giant' handwritten beneath, and the VO begins (about 12.0). On 'the giant' the hand sets the giant down on the line about a third of the way across the page, just right of the scattered cards — a torn-edge deep-navy silhouette, broad shoulders, a scribbled beard, big flat feet — and a forest-green tick appears on the line under each foot. On 'Lifted' (about 17.5) the hand pinches his shoulders and lifts him off the line: as he rises his navy fill drains to a hollow, translucent outline, he tilts and wobbles like a leaf with his arms dangling, and the green ticks fade; 'lifted = weak · same with deals' is scrawled beside him. On 'weak' the hand sets him back down: solid navy again, tiny cream paper crumbs puff at his feet, the green ticks return, and 'grounded = strong' is scrawled by the ticks. The beat ends on the solid giant standing on the line, with about 0.7s of quiet after the VO. No fold and no mark yet — the mark is drawn once, in beat 9.
beats.sound: A string 'zip' as it pulls taut and a snap as it straightens; a quick cascade of card drops; a deep soft thunk as the giant's feet land; a rising, airy paper flutter as he lifts, with a thin uneasy string note; thunk again on the return with a puff of crumbs; pen scratches for the two notes. Music swells on the name, wobbles on the lift, resolves on the landing.

beats.vo: Tell it once who you sell to and who you're chasing. It fills in the rest.
beats.vo_spoken: Tell it once who you sell to, and who you're chasing. It fills in the rest.
beats.on_screen: Serif: "Tell it once." · handwritten index card: "who we sell to" (an illegible scribble beneath) · company cards in navy serif: Boeing, Starbucks, OpenAI, Chipotle, Sweetgreen, Notion · handwritten label: "where each deal stands" · blue slips, one at a time: Boeing · "new head of operations" / Notion · "hiring twelve sellers" / Chipotle · "opening forty stores"
beats.visual: In the first second, with no hand on him, the giant quietly settles and shrinks into the small navy Grounded A at his spot on the line — two legs, a low crossbar, the line running past its feet — and the two scrawled notes fade. The A stays there for the rest of the film. Everything the founder tells it, she places herself: her own paper hand, reaching across from her seat, sets a cream index card on the line beside the A on 'Tell it once' — 'who we sell to' in handwriting with an illegible scribbled line beneath — then tapes down the company cards to its right, plain cream paper with names in navy serif and a tape corner on each: Boeing, Starbucks and OpenAI as three deliberate placements, then Chipotle, Sweetgreen and Notion landing as one quick fan (they read as 'and more', not as text to read). She taps the scattered little cards into a short row on the line between the A and the companies, under the handwritten label 'where each deal stands'. Then, on 'It fills in the rest', with no hand at all, three blue paper slips slide out from behind named company cards on their own — blue is what Antaeus knows — one at a time with a breath between (about 24.9, 25.7, 26.5), each tied to its card by a small doodle arrow: Boeing · 'new head of operations', Notion · 'hiring twelve sellers', Chipotle · 'opening forty stores'. Standing facts only; nothing about money yet. No margin notes. The founder sits back with her arms folded, watching it fill in; the loud note hops once on the pile, ignored. The tile in the corner still reads 'You are the system'. About 0.8s of quiet after the VO.
beats.sound: A soft paper settle as the giant becomes the A; a deliberate paper slide for the index card; three tape rips, then one quick fan flutter for the last three company cards; a light tap-tap as the deal row is squared; then three spaced pen ticks, one per blue slip, with a small doodle scribble for each arrow. Music steady and a shade brighter, a light melody joining the bed.

beats.vo: Every morning, it hands you the one thing to do first, and why.
beats.vo_spoken: Every morning, it hands you the one thing to do first, and why.
beats.on_screen: Serif: "The one thing to do first." · the tape label re-lands: "Founder · Tuesday morning" · blue airplane stamp: "JUST RAISED MONEY" · orange-ruled card: "Write to OpenAI first" · blue handwriting beneath it: "why: fresh money · hiring fast"
beats.visual: Morning on the same page — no page flip. A cream paper sun with a navy outline rises up the left margin behind the founder and throws long, soft shadows across the grid; as it rises, the tape strip in the top-left peels off and re-lands reading 'Founder · Tuesday morning'. The calm hand squares the sticky-note heap into one neat little stack on the far corner of the desk (the loud note squeaks once going in, then goes quiet) — the desk and the stack never leave the page. Then a paper airplane folded from blue newsprint glides in from the top-right, stamped 'JUST RAISED MONEY', and lands on the OpenAI card with a small bounce and a papery flap — the morning's new event, not a standing fact. The company cards dim in place, still a row standing on the line, and the little deal-state cards tuck behind their company cards. The OpenAI card slides forward out of the row to front-centre, where it takes the only orange on the page: a thick orange masking-tape strip down its left edge, its note reading 'Write to OpenAI first' (on 'first', about 31.4). On 'and why' a blue handwritten line writes itself beneath it with a doodle arrow — Antaeus talking — 'why: fresh money · hiring fast'; it stays on the page, readable, well into the next beat. Nothing else moves.
beats.sound: A gentle rising pluck for the sun; a tape peel and re-press for the label; a short paper shuffle and one squeak as the heap is squared; a soft whoosh and a papery flap-landing for the airplane; a quiet slide as the row dims and the deal cards tuck in; one clear plucked note plus a firm soft thunk as the orange card lands; pen scratch for the 'why'. Music lifts.

beats.vo: When a deal slips, it says so, with the smallest step that saves it.
beats.vo_spoken: When a deal slips, it says so, with the smallest step that saves it.
beats.on_screen: Red handwritten tag (the only red in the film): "11 days quiet · no next step" · navy handwritten beside the drifting card: "lifted" · blue strip: "smallest step: book Thursday's call" · forest-green handwriting: "back on the ground"
beats.visual: The Sweetgreen card slides out of the dimmed row on its own, then begins to drift upward like a leaf — tilting as it rises, its navy ink thinning to pale and hollow (the lifted giant again), a faint dashed trail under it; a one-word navy 'lifted' is scrawled beside it. A small red handwritten tag attaches to its corner. The founder half-reaches for the drifting card from her seat and misses (about 35.2). On 'it says so' a blue strip slides in along the line on its own, no hand — Antaeus talking, no orange on it — carrying the smallest step. She reads it, picks it up herself, tucks it under the drifting card, and on 'saves it' (about 39.3) presses the card firmly back down onto the ground line with her own paper hand — the calm hand stays out of this beat entirely; the tool names the step, the person takes it. On contact the card fills back to solid navy with a thunk, a forest-green tick appears on the line beneath it, and the red tag falls away and crumples. Forest-green handwriting settles beside it: 'back on the ground'. About 0.7s of quiet after the VO.
beats.sound: A slow airy flutter rising as the card drifts, with a thin held string note; a scratchy red-pen stroke for the tag; a small whiff as her first reach misses; a paper slide for the blue strip; a firm double-thunk as she presses the card down; a tiny crumple as the red tag drops; pen scribble for the green note. Music dips tense on the drift, resolves warm on the thunk.

beats.vo: Everything settles into a short handoff book.
beats.vo_spoken: Everything settles into a short handoff book.
beats.on_screen: Serif: "The handoff book." · handwritten on the forest-green cover: "If a hire started Monday" · seven small tabs, legible if paused, not meant to be read at speed: who we win with · outreach that landed · questions that won · where deals leak · the losses · why we win · the week
beats.visual: Every card on the line — the company row, the blue slips, the orange card, the recovered Sweetgreen card — lifts gently, shrinks, and drifts toward the spot beside the small A, stacking like pages into a small paper booklet with a forest-green cover (forest is the colour of things that last); the cover line is already handwritten as it forms, and a strip of masking tape wraps the spine mid-drift. The book lands on the ground line beside the A on the word 'book' with a soft thump, and seven paper tabs riffle out along its right edge in the same movement, one per part. The founder at the desk and the hire at the right margin watch from either side. The tile still reads 'You are the system'.
beats.sound: Soft paper rustle as everything gathers; a tape rip on the spine mid-air; a book thump as it lands on the line, folding straight into a seven-count riffle (thk-thk-thk-thk-thk-thk-thk). Music: a warm swell, fuller.

beats.vo: Your first sales hire walks in and runs it without you.
beats.vo_spoken: Your first sales hire walks in, and runs it without you.
beats.on_screen: Top-corner paper tile flips like a scoreboard on "without you": "You are the system" (navy) → "Hire-ready" (forest green)
beats.visual: The hire steps forward along the ground line from the right margin where he has stood since beat 2 (no second entrance); his faint '?' pops away, and he picks up the green book and opens it. On 'and runs it' the cards fan back out along the line around him, every one of them standing on the line, none floating. At the same time the founder stands up from the desk, takes her mug, gives a small wave, and walks to the left margin with the same paper-puppet walk, where she leans and watches him work — still on the page, away from the desk, not gone. Nothing on the line wobbles as she goes. He does not sit at her desk and props nothing on the mug; he stands on the line with the open book. On 'without you' (about 48.6) the small paper tile in the top corner flips over: it has read 'You are the system' in navy since beat 2; it now reads 'Hire-ready' in forest green. Hold about 0.7s.
beats.sound: Two small paper footsteps forward; a soft pop for the '?'; a page flip; a paper fan-out flutter; a mug clink and three soft footsteps to the margin; a satisfying tile flip-clack on 'Hire-ready'. Music settles into a warm held chord.

beats.vo: Antaeus. Try the demo at antaeus dot app.
beats.vo_spoken: Antaeus. Try the demo at Antaeus dot app.
beats.on_screen: Serif: "Antaeus" · serif tagline: "Your first hire could run this." · serif on the ground line: "antaeus.app" · orange paper button: "Try the demo" · handwritten: "free · no card needed" · handwritten: "a sample company inside" · handwritten: "works beside what you already use" · tiny "zzz" over the sleeping loud note
beats.visual: The book, the cards, the founder and the hire fade off the page; what stays is the ground line, the small A, and the desk in the bottom-left corner with its neat stack. The A slides to the centre of the line and, on the spoken 'Antaeus', the marker draws over it large in three strokes: the left leg up to the apex, the right leg down, then the low crossbar last, settling like a needle on a gauge; the line already runs well past both feet. Navy only, edges boiling gently — the mark never takes the orange. The serif 'Antaeus' sets beside the mark, the tagline beneath it, then 'antaeus.app' in serif sitting on the ground line as the URL is spoken. The calm hand places a single orange paper button — 'Try the demo' — just under the URL and presses it flat: the one thing to do next, the second and last orange in the film. It gives one slow paper breath (lifts a millimetre, settles). Three small handwritten notes settle in the margin, one after another. On the desk corner the loud note is asleep on top of the neat stack with a tiny 'zzz'. Hold on the mark for the last second; soft page flip to black at 55.0.
beats.sound: Three pen strokes for the A with a slight squeak at the apex; a soft thunk as the crossbar settles; a pen flourish for the wordmark and the URL; a paper slide and a light press for the orange button; three tiny pen scribbles for the notes; a paper sigh for the 'zzz'. Music resolves on a warm chord and holds; a soft page-flip to black at the very end.
